extracted.intended_audience: institutions and investigators applying to or managing awards from the U.S. Department of Energy Office of Science (including higher education, non-profit and for-profit research organizations, and DOE National Laboratories)
extracted.subtask_description: A consolidated set of Office of Science resources and guidance for preparing applications, managing awards, and complying with DOE/Office of Science policies (data management, reporting, public access, acknowledgements, institutional classifications). Useful both for prospective applicants and current awardees.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grants Process (application and award steps)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provides a high-level overview of the steps in the application and award processes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this overview to understand the sequence of actions and milestones when preparing and submitting applications and when managing the post-award process. Treat the listed steps as the baseline procedural checklist for DOE Office of Science proposals and awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statement on Digital Data Management / Data Management Plans (DMPs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provides guidance regarding effective management, preservation, and sharing of digital research data and the Office of Science’s implementation of the DOE requirement for Data Management Plans.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare and submit a Data Management Plan that meets DOE/Office of Science expectations for management, preservation, and sharing of digital research data. Follow the guidance to ensure the DMP addresses preservation, accessibility, and compliance with DOE policy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Awardee FAQs (post-award compliance and administration)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provides responses to questions awardees may have during the award period.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult the Awardee FAQs for clarifications on administrative requirements, reporting, allowable costs, and other common post-award issues. Use the FAQ answers to align award management practices with Office of Science expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enhancing Research Transparency (public abstracts & progress reports via PAMS)
rubrics_metrics.description: Webinar recording (presentation) provides information about how public abstracts and public research performance progress reports submitted for SC financial assistance and laboratory awards will be made available online through the Portfolio Analysis and Management System (PAMS).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure that public abstracts and progress reports are prepared with the knowledge they will be made publicly available through PAMS. Follow webinar/presentation guidance on content, timing, and formats to meet transparency requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Laboratory Progress Reports (collection & public reporting via PAMS)
rubrics_metrics.description: Dedicated webinar (presentation) focusing on how annual research performance progress reports for SC laboratory awards will be collected and related public progress reports will be generated through PAMS.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For DOE laboratory awards, follow the specified procedures for submitting annual performance progress reports so PAMS can generate public-facing progress reports. Adhere to the collection schedule and content guidance provided in the webinar.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Product Reporting Enhancement (PAMS & E-Link integration; RPPR & STI reporting)
rubrics_metrics.description: Webinar recording (presentation) provides information about the PAMS and Energy Link (E-Link) systems integration that streamlines satisfying both the Research Performance Progress Report (RPPR) and Scientific and Technical Information (STI) reporting requirements for products resulting from SC awards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the integrated PAMS/E-Link workflow to submit RPPRs and STI products efficiently. Follow the integration guidance to avoid duplicate submissions and to ensure both RPPR and STI requirements are satisfied.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institution Designations/Classifications
rubrics_metrics.description: Provides a list of institutions with the following specified: Minority-Serving Institution designation, Carnegie classification, and Emerging Research Institution classification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refer to this list to determine institutional classifications that may affect eligibility, reporting, or program targeting. Ensure institutional claims (e.g., MSI status) match the official designations used by the Office of Science.

rubrics_metrics.name: DOE Public Access (public access plan & OSTI portals)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provides links to DOE’s Public Access Plan and OSTI portal of searchable sites for scholarly publications, digital data, and other results of DOE-sponsored research and development (R&D).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comply with DOE public access policy by depositing publications, data, and other research outputs in the appropriate OSTI repositories and following the DOE Public Access Plan timelines and metadata requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award Search / Public Abstracts (PAMS searchability)
rubrics_metrics.description: Links to the Office of Science’s public Portfolio Analysis and Management System (PAMS) site where one can search for grants, cooperative agreements, and interagency awards funded by the Office of Science.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Publish clear public abstracts and use PAMS to locate comparable awards, understand funding patterns, and verify public information about Office of Science awards. Ensure submitted public abstracts meet the Office of Science's expectations for content and clarity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acknowledgements of Federal Support (required acknowledgement language and guidance)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provides guidance on acknowledging Office of Science-sponsored work in technical publications, news releases, mailings, public websites, and social media.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the specified wording and procedures for acknowledging DOE Office of Science support in publications and public communications. Proper acknowledgements help ensure compliance with funding terms and support discoverability of funded work.
